Exhibit 99.1

 

Quarterly Statement Q3 2026

 

 

 

 

 

Current cloud backlog of €24.1 billion, up 28% and up 26% at constant currencies

 

Cloud revenue up 26% and up 25% at constant currencies

 

Cloud ERP Suite revenue up 29% and up 28% at constant currencies

 

Total revenue up 13% and up 12% at constant currencies

 

IFRS operating profit up 18%, non-IFRS operating profit up 18%, both at nominal and constant currencies

 

SAP updates its 2026 cloud revenue and cloud and software revenue outlook

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Christian Klein, CEO:

 

Q3 was an outstanding quarter, with current cloud backlog up 26% at constant currencies. Our Autonomous Enterprise strategy is not just resonating, it is being adopted. Our customers are investing in the technology behind it – from the cloud and data foundation to our Business AI. They see that Joule Work makes the business case for their transformation more attractive than ever.

 

 

 

Dominik Asam, CFO:

 

For the first time, SAP crossed €10 billion in total quarterly revenue and €3 billion of non-IFRS operating profit, reflecting the strength and scalability of our business model. Our disciplined approach to cost management, paired with continued cloud momentum, demonstrates our ability to grow both the top and bottom line at the same time.
